14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

3557|a43ce262.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|a43ce262.text: Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6741|0f322cd8.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|0f322cd8.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity; the upper courtyards are what you seek.

6741|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6741|c3a29bdb.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|c3a29bdb.text:
Our ancient lands are in the northeast of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and offers many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately, its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity, but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

79096-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79096-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
